annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive relating to motor vehicles and their trailers transporting certain animals, amending Directive 70/156/EEC in respect of the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive relating to motor vehicles and their trailers transporting certain animals, amending Directive 70/156/EEC in respect of the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.summary_en: 1997 European Commission proposal for a directive setting EC type-approval technical requirements for motor vehicles and trailers transporting livestock, as a separate directive under Directive 70/156/EEC. It covers floors, ventilation, ramps, partitions and lighting by animal class. It is not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes harmonised EC type-approval technical requirements for animal transport vehicles and superstructures
Classifies animals into classes A–E with class-specific floor, wall, ventilation and ramp requirements
Harmonisation is optional until the framework directive becomes mandatory for these vehicles
Requires identification and user plates on approved transport units
Member States must transpose by 1 November 1998 and apply from 1 May 1999
